sections.evaluation_comments:
8/14/2026
Dog was closed inside for cleaning, sitting against gate, low growling. Handler spoke softly, offered treats, dog accepted. Stood and stepped forward when handler opened gate, flinched on leash contact but allowed it. Exited, walked very slowly, cautiously, needing encouragement. Dog was easily startled by reactive dogs and darted forward, able to be coaxed into settling. Once away from kennels, dog walked a little faster but still cautiously. In yard, handler slowly began adjusting leash stopper, dog turned and side-eyed handler several times. Handler waited until dog was distracted with sniffing to adjust stopper fully. Dropped leash. Dog explored cautiously, tail down, keeping distance from handler. Would not approach when called. Leash became stuck on pool, handler approached slowly to fix it, dog appeared startled, darted away from handler. Handler sat on bench, spoke softly, gave dog time. Dog eventually approached handler, tense body, sniffed handler's legs and shoes, occasional side-eye. Ate treats left on grass. Wandered away, maintained distance. Handler walked to gate, called dog, dog approached. Tense body as handler retrieved leash. Dog walked with more confidence on return but still slow, easily startled. More stop and go to sniff on return. Slowed and sniffed calm dogs in kennels, tail down, startled by reactive dogs. Entered own kennel easily, leash removed via clip lead as precaution.
8/13/2026
Closed inside for AM cleaning. Dog was tense and alarm barking as handler approached, head low, whale eyed, settled to eat treats tossed in kennel, hard stared and alarm barked at hand when offering treats. Backed away when presented with leash, able to reach in and place with large loop, dog exited kennel, slow walk to yard, stop and go, tail tucked and head low, wary of surroundings, continued walking with verbal coaxing and gentle leash pressure, able to adjust leash stopper. Dog explored yard, neutral body, nose to ground, approached to sniff treat pouch, after a moment slowly approached with verbal coaxing, pancaked in front of handler, whale eyed, allowed light petting on head, ignored treats placed on ground, scanned environment, air scenting, did not actively seek attention. Followed handler into catch pen, able to pick up leash and attach clip leash, skin crawled when pet on back, slow walk back to kennel, easy return, tense with wide eyes as handler slowly removed leash by hand.
8/12/2026
Laying at front whale eyed and low growled when handler approached. Requesting full eval based on kennel presence and intake notes.
8/10/2026
nervous, wide eyed, skittish when pet, allowed all handling, not seeking attention, allowed vaccinations, walked to kennel

sections.evaluation_comments:
8/17/2026
Dog was closed to back half of kennel during AM cleaning.  Would approach kennel gate while keeping ears pinned back, head lowered & tail tucked under body.  Was not interested in treats.  Slowly leaned into kennel to cast a large loop leash.  Walked with a moderate pull on leash, would stop to sniff nearby non-reactive kennels & would walk fast past reactive kennels.  Once in PY, dog would keep tail slightly tucked under body & have ears in a neutral position.  Would explore with nose to ground while licking green turf & PY gates.  Would not be interested in treats.  Would dart across PY when hearing loud noises.  Handler would call dog over, dog would slowly approach while keeping an arms length distance with head lowered, licking lips & tucking tail fully under body.  Would sniff handlers hand then walk away.  Started to pace along fence line while panting heavy with a flagged tail & ears flattened.  Handler would step on leash to pick up.  Would flip head back & lower body when adjusting leash stopper & attaching a clip leash.  Handler would wait a few moments then gently touch dog on back, would quickly lower body, pin ears back & lick lips while walking quickly to gate.  Walked back to kennel slowly along side handler while keeping ears pinned back, panting heavy with mouth wide open & tail tucked under body.  Would not enter into kennel with treats or verbal coaxing.  Handler would fully walk into kennel for dog to follow then quickly stepped out.  Removed leash with use of clip leash.
8/16/2026
Dog was closed outside for cleaning, standing with stoic body, tail down. Air-scented towards handler, briefly came forward, sniffed offered treat but did not take, stepped back. Handler opened gate, presented leash, dog sniffed leash. Ducked away from leash placement and retreated to back of kennel, would not come forward. Handler stepped in, able to use large loop to lasso leash. Dog flinched but tolerated it. Exited kennel, no reaction to neighboring dogs. Walked with light pull, some zig zag. Handler adjust leash stopper as dog was sniffing plants nearby. Walked to main play yard, dog thrashed on leash once at gate, then followed in behind handler. Handler dropped leash. Dog kept large distance from handler, exploring yard with tail down, head low. No response to verbal coaxing but would look up when called by name, then continue sniffing. Would not approach handler after several minutes, maintained distance. Handler stood, slowly approached, dog quickly evaded handler, looking back over shoulder. Handler walked slowly, spoke gently, no sudden movements as dog continued to pace in circles to avoid them. Handler was able to step on leash, pick it up. Dog pulled back briefly on leash, jumped back from handler, settled, able to be led to yard gate. Dog sniffed handler's hand a few times, sniffed treat, did not take, remained tense and on alert. Turned head quickly towards handler when attempting to adjust leash stopper. Handler walked dog out of yard, able to adjust stopper once dog was distracted. Light pull. Dog sniffed a calm dog through gate, wagged tail, moved on. Pulled back at kennel, would not enter, then followed in behind handler. Handler used straight-arm on leash while stepping out, then removed leash via clip lead.
8/15/2026
Timid, wide eyed, not seeking attention, flinches when petting, skin crawling for handling, allowed some handling and vaccines with muzzle wrap restraint, thrashed during restraint, push gate used for remainder of vaccines, walked to kennel, clip lead used to remove leash.
